paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: There are understandable reasons why people may support the proposal that teachers should allow phones for carefully planned classroom activities. I consider this a mainly positive development when it is organised with practical needs in mind. Its value comes from the help it can offer in daily life, rather than from the idea simply sounding modern or attractive.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 1 — vì sao?
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can quickly access useful learning material. This is possible because a shared task can direct phone use towards a specific question rather than casual browsing. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

For example,
parts.labelVi: Đưa ví dụ + mệnh đề

parts.text: a teenager can play with friends after finishing homework and still join a weekend football match. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

paragraphs.label: Câu hỏi 2 — đánh giá
paragraphs.text: I see the development as positive because it gives people a useful option, provided that the main obstacles are recognised. One concern is that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits. This is connected with the fact that families sometimes set limits without discussing how the activity works. Ignoring that concern would weaken the case for the proposal, so support should include an effort to improve how it works.

paragraphs.label: Ví dụ về điều kiện
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to agree on realistic finishing times and responsibilities before play begins. For example, a family could decide on a final match and keep the same bedtime on school nights. This approach is useful because it deals with a specific obstacle instead of simply repeating a general message. It could first be tried on a small scale, with feedback from the people involved, and then adjusted if some needs have been overlooked.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, people have good reason to support this approach because players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs. I regard it as mainly positive, but the result depends on practical planning. A flexible approach that listens to the people involved is more likely to deliver the intended value.
